snippet.title: Fugue Shot | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Fugue Shot is the Arcade Roguelike - each run, you’ll jump between multiple game modes manifested as surreal dreams. Choose your path, adapt your playstyle, and collect Memories to create game-breaking builds and change how each mode plays. Can you escape this ever-shifting dream?

Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3538440/Fugue_Shot/?utm_source=social&utm_medium=youtube&utm_campaign=f_s

Join the Discord!
https://discord.gg/8fjGG937

Follow us on socials!
https://fugueshot.com

--

Each run in Fugue Shot takes place in a shifting dreamscape filled with dangerous encounters known as the Omens, ranging from strategic puzzles to fast-paced action arenas. Face these challenges and collect Memories that alter properties across all Omens, reshaping the dream and the way you play. Can you overcome the unstable terrain of this liminal world, or will it consume you?

MULTIPLE PLAYSTYLES, ONE RUN
Face any of over 8 different Omens, each offering a distinct arcade-inspired experience. Pick between Omens to challenge, and strategize accordingly across intense combat, precision-based reaction tests, physics-driven puzzles, and more - all within one run. As you progress, Omens evolve, growing in complexity and intensity as they drag you deeper into the dream.

POWER UP YOUR RUN
Discover over 150 unique Memories that transform how you approach each Omen, adapting your playstyle and bending the dream. Choose upgrades that enhance your abilities, unleash powerful synergies, and create game-breaking builds. Fill out entries in your Dream Journal to chart the dreamscape for future runs, and chip away at over 80 permanent unlocks.

AN EERILY BEAUTIFUL WORLD
Stunning and stylish pixel art compliments a hypnotic and meditative soundtrack to create a surreal, dreamy atmosphere. The world of Fugue Shot is a vivid dream designed to get lost in.
